failure_type: late detection (short sensing range) + UAV too fast to react + wind
explanation: The UAV collided with an obstacle after detecting it only 0.7 seconds before the closest approach. The combination of a high cruise speed of 8.9 m/s and strong wind gusts reaching 7.3 m/s left insufficient time for the planner to navigate around the obstacle. The flight ended in a collision with a minimum clearance of -0.23 meters.
